headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty ended lower, snapping a four-week winning streak as IT stocks dragged.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 1 December.

why: Brent crude oil prices rose significantly, topping $97 per barrel
The IT sector underperformed and dragged down the benchmark indices
Profit booking occurred after a consistent four-week market rally
Weak global market cues weighed on investor sentiment during the session
whatHappening: The Sensex and Nifty 50 snapped their four-week winning streak on Friday
The Sensex tumbled 460 points in early trade during the last session
Nifty 50 dropped below the 25,900 level during Friday's trading
HDFC Bank announced it will stop sending SMS alerts for UPI transactions under Rs 200 from January
summary: Indian benchmarks ended in the red on Friday, snapping a four-week rally as high Brent crude prices and a drag in IT stocks pressured the market. The Sensex fell over 460 points while the Nifty 50 slipped below 25,900 amid profit booking. Notable stock movements included TCS leading weekly gains while Tata Steel lagged behind.
